weight_description: Calculated pair weight: 284 g (ST-RX810-L) + 286 g (ST-RX810-R) = 570 g, using separately published manufacturer side weights for the exact 2x11 hydraulic controls. This is a lever pair, not a complete hose/caliper brake system.
